limitations: Performance qualification is limited to one warmed concurrency-one decode measurement.
Prefill, higher concurrency, alternative backends, K7, LMCache replay, and filesystem L2 were not remeasured for this source composition.
The 40 GiB native CPU KV offload path was enabled, but no eviction or replay workload was executed.
Performance values describe a PCIe-switch TP2 subset and do not claim identical throughput on direct-root-port or dual-socket topologies.
